verdict.rationale: Ramp's llms.txt index links a canonical OpenAPI schema at /openapi/developer-api.json, plus a generated plain-text endpoint and schema reference (/llms-api.txt) and full exports. Its unauthenticated Developer MCP also gives AI assistants live access to the OpenAPI schemas through a developer_docs_schema tool. The llms.txt index was live-probed (HTTP 200), which corroborates the machine-readable docs surface. Missing for 10: no hands-on probe or independent confirmation that the OpenAPI JSON file itself downloads and is complete.
